home.title: About Me
home.paragraph1: Shipping software professionally since 2017, from {clujLink}, Romania, across multinationals, startups, and midsize companies. Currently at {innovatorSparkLink}, turning ideas into working products (designed, built, tested, deployed, and operated end to end) and putting new technology to work where it creates the most value for users and the business.
home.paragraph2: I have constantly been trying to improve my skills and I don't hesitate when I realize that there is still a lot to learn, so I am always open to new challenges.
home.paragraph3: Check out my {githubLink} to explore my latest projects and my {cvLink} for a full breakdown of my professional journey.
home.paragraph4: Besides my profession I also love to relax and recharge my batteries with my friends and family and of course by doing my favourite hobbies.

letsTalk.title: Let's talk if...

idea.text: You have an idea and need someone to turn it into a product people can actually use.

stuck.text: You already have software, and adding features or handling growth has turned slow and painful.

ship.text: You built something that never left your laptop, and you want it live on the web or on phones.

team.text: Your team needs a better developer experience, and you want modern tooling and AI to get there without cutting corners.

hiring.text: Your team needs a senior software engineer who is a real team player.

projects.text: You saw one of my projects and want to talk about it.
